result: The conservative predictable-weight CS can be tightened by replacing the minimum-slope denominator bound with the exact worst-case denominator over all conditional-mean vectors having the candidate weighted average.

setup.target: m = sum_i w_i mu_i / W, W=sum_i w_i

exact_envelope.definition: D_max(m)=max prod_i(1-a_i mu_i) subject to 0<=mu_i<=1 and sum_i w_i mu_i=W*m
exact_envelope.validity: For the true weighted mean, the actual denominator D(mu) is <=D_max, so E_lambda is pathwise <= the corresponding nonnegative supermartingale. Fixed convex mixtures remain dominated and Ville-valid.
exact_envelope.equal_weight_recovery: If all w_i=1 then all a_i are equal; concavity/Jensen gives mu_i=m at the maximum and D_max=(1-(1-exp(-lambda))*m)^t, exactly recovering the original equal-process construction.

water_filling_solution.objective: maximize sum_i log(1-a_i mu_i) under the weighted-mean equality
water_filling_solution.KKT: Interior coordinates satisfy mu_i=1/a_i-c/w_i for one scalar c; clip each coordinate to [0,1].
water_filling_solution.solve: Choose c so sum_i w_i*clip(1/a_i-c/w_i,0,1)=W*m. The left side is monotone in c, enabling one-dimensional bisection or an exact breakpoint/water-filling implementation.
water_filling_solution.breakpoints: mu_i switches 0/interior at c=w_i/a_i and interior/1 at c=w_i(1-a_i)/a_i.

comparison_to_conservative_weighted_boun.relation: The exact envelope is always at least as powerful because the conservative proof upper-bounds D_max further using 1-x<=exp(-x) and the minimum ratio (1-exp(-lambda w))/w.
comparison_to_conservative_weighted_boun.interpretation: The exact envelope gives modest but consistent finite-sample savings in these synthetic patterns and, more importantly, recovers the original tight construction when weights are equal.

measurement_rules: Weights must be predictable. Realized cluster size that can depend on the current outcome is not licensed by this derivation.
If request weighting is desired and exposure can be prospectively blockized into equal-size units, the equal-weight construction is simpler and tighter than retrospective unequal-size weighting.
The exact envelope target is a time-varying weighted average conditional mean; do not running-intersect endpoints across times without a separate constant-target theorem.
Numerical water-filling implementation must preserve monotonicity and fail closed on cap/weight-contract violations.
scope: The process-count benchmarks are synthetic deterministic weight patterns, not measured production latency or mismatch traffic.
No claim is made that the modest savings shown here dominate alternative importance-weighted CS constructions outside this bounded conditional-mean contract.
No forbidden semantic inputs were read.
